label: Version 1.5.3
releaseNotes: Smaller current-dates control with a short label and helper text.
Manifest files are optional: use Generate Manifest after a completed job.
Payment Authority Code dropdown options show only the numeric code.
Payment Authority Code now uses the searchable SEOC-style dropdown with saved selections.
New referrals default to current dates; expiration follows Referral Period and custom dates remain available.
Master JSON uses consistent readable formatting and naturally ordered filenames.
Payment Authority Codes now come from the team reference list, with 43 unique codes and no automatic incrementing.
Referral Number choices are VA and Custom; ICN choices are Default, Custom, and Referral Number.
Keep individual formatted JSON, a combined formatted master JSON, or only gzip. Generate a manifest separately when needed.
Repeated runs overwrite matching filenames after validation and preserve unrelated files.
Stations, Networks, payment codes, and SEOC pairs stay within approved selections; selecting all clears selected subsets.
Referral and LEIE uploads use one sequential queue, skip duplicate destinations, and continue after a failed server.
Dialogs scroll on smaller screens and at higher zoom so confirmation buttons remain reachable.
The Setup installer distinguishes a fresh installation from an upgrade in the selected folder.
Updated Electron and Playwright; added output validation and batch regression coverage.
teamHighlights: Correct dropdown values: Stations, Networks, and SEOC values follow your selections. Payment Authority Codes use the team’s 43 unique codes and no longer increment.
Simpler choices: Referral Number offers VA or Custom; ICN offers Default, Custom, or Referral Number. Payment codes use a searchable, numbers-only dropdown.
Flexible output: Keep individual JSON files, a combined master JSON, or just .gz. Matching filenames are overwritten after validation.
Current dates: New referrals use current dates; expiration follows Referral Period. Custom dates remain available.
Improved uploads: Servers are handled one at a time, duplicate destinations are avoided, and the queue continues if a server fails.
Easier to use: Compact date controls, scrollable dialogs at higher zoom, and automatic output validation. Generate Manifest is optional after completion.
